args.title: AC-1: Cart lists each added product with its quantity, name and price
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user|Sign-in succeeds and the product list is shown
2. Click the first Add to cart button in the product list|Cart badge shows "1"
3. Click the cart icon to navigate to the cart|The cart page displays "Your Cart"
4. Inspect the cart contents|The cart item quantity shows "1", the product name is visible, and the product price is visible

args.title: AC-2: Removing a product in the cart takes it off the list and lowers the cart badge
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user|Sign-in succeeds and the product list is shown
2. Click the first Add to cart button in the product list|Cart badge shows "1"
3. Click the cart icon to navigate to the cart|The cart page displays "Your Cart" and the cart item name is visible
4. Click "Remove"|The cart item list is empty (no cart_item elements visible)
5. Check the cart badge|The cart badge is not shown

args.title: AC-3: Continue shopping returns to the product list with the cart unchanged
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user|Sign-in succeeds and the product list is shown
2. Click the first Add to cart button in the product list|Cart badge shows "1"
3. Click the cart icon to navigate to the cart|The cart page displays "Your Cart"
4. Click "Continue Shopping"|The product list page is shown ("Products" heading is visible)
5. Check the cart badge on the product list page|The cart badge still shows "1" (cart is unchanged)
